cross_cutting_gaps.description: Historical pre-identity-validation profiles with avatar.userId different from the active pointer are omitted locally; upstream registry reduction can preserve their profile identity. Preserve this as an observed resolver difference until source golden coverage and an explicit implementation decision resolve it.

Optional SNS publishing exists for referral events. Friendship and community notification producers still require source-compatible SNS wiring; writing a local inbox does not preserve existing external subscribers. Deployed subscriptions, duplicate delivery and cutover remain unverified.

Mutation fanout now uses the existing core NATS link; two real broker connections, scoped delivery and large public snapshots pass locally. Deployed replica/consumer behavior and burst/outage equivalence remain unverified; the256-entry outbound queue can drop before source per-subscription limits.

Audience scope/generation/24-hour refreshed expiry now persist in shared SQL. Restart, expiry, generation-CAS and retained immutable event snapshots pass local tests. Existing room state, external media continuity and deployed cutover remain unverified.

Attribution/IP rejection, signup, UTC login days, guarded grants, artwork and email now have source-paired/local regressions and optional real SQS/SNS SDK transport. Source-specific database error envelopes and Slack alert side effects remain gaps; stateful cutover is unverified.

Dynamic moderators and ranking producers are implemented with focused source/local regressions. Enabled AI compliance remains under implementation. Existing lifetime counter baselines and watermarks are not imported, so historical ranking equality remains unverified.

The implemented SQL limiter now matches eight executed source/Redis scenarios plus concurrent replica, fixed-expiry and configuration regressions. Existing Redis counter state has not been imported or drained during a nonempty cutover; a fresh SQL counter resets the active window.

No nonempty migration snapshot, deployed provider/edge configuration, active LiveKit call continuity, running-client comparison or rollback rehearsal has been supplied or executed. These are replacement acceptance requirements, separate from local contract tests.

Configured official SQS/SNS transports preserve legacy raw events and attributes locally; deployed queue policies,topic subscriptions and real credential access have not been exercised. The additive upgrade preserves populated candidate IDs in synthetic tests; import of existing upstream progress/login-days/reward/email state and live cutover remain outstanding. Ranking event dispatch and other SNS producer wiring are subsequent packages.

The pinned HTTP server applies HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES and rejects oversized declared bodies with413 before authentication; the current gateway still uses handler-level hardcoded limits. Declared/chunked body overflow, configured limits, response/CORS and connection-close behavior need a full boundary comparison and fix.
